content: संस्कारः .²1 Making perfect, refining, polishing; (मणिः) प्रयुक्तसंस्कार इवाधिकं बभौ <ls>R. 3. 18</ls>. .²2 Refinement, perfection, grammatical purity (as of words); संस्कारवत्येव गिरा मनीषी <ls>Ku. 1. 28</ls> (where <ls>Malli.</ls> renders the word by व्याकरणजन्या शुद्धिः); <ls>R. 15. 76</ls>. .²3 Education, cultivation, training (as of the mind); निसर्गसंस्कारविनीत इत्यसौ नृपेण चक्रे युवराजशब्दभाक् <ls>R. 3. 35</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 10</ls>. .²4 Making ready, preparation. .²5 Cooking, dressing (as of food <ab>&c.</ab>). .²6 Embellishment, decoration, ornament; स्वभावसुन्दरं वस्तु न संस्कारमपेक्षते <ls>Dṛ. Ś. 49</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 23</ls>; <ls>Mu. 2. 10</ls>. .²7 Consecration, sanctification, hallowing; संस्कारो नाम स भवति यस्मिञ्जाते पदार्थो भवति योग्यः कस्यचिदर्थस्य <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 1. 3</ls>. .²8 Impression, form, mould, operation, influence; यन्नवे भाजने लग्नः संस्कारो नान्यथा भवेत् <ls>H. Pr. 8</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 84</ls>. .²9 Idea, notion, conception. .²10 Any faculty or capacity. .²11 Effect of work, merit of action; फलानुमेयाः प्रारम्भाः संस्काराः प्राक्तना इव <ls>R. 1. 20</ls>. .²12 The self-reproductive quality, faculty of impression; one of the 24 qualities or guṇas recognised by the Vaiśeṣikas; it is of three kinds: भावना, वेग, and स्थितिस्थापकता <ab>qq. vv.</ab> .²13 The faculty of recollection, impression on the memory; संस्कारमात्रजन्यं ज्ञानं स्मृतिः <ls>T. S.</ls> .²14 A purificatory rite, a sacred rite or ceremony; संस्कारार्थं शरीरस्य <ls>Ms. 2. 66</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 78</ls>; (Manu mentions 12 such Saṃskāras <ab>viz.</ab> 1 गर्भाधान, 2 पुंसवन, 3 सीमन्तोन्नयन, 4 जातकर्मन्, 5 नामकर्मन्, 6 निष्क्रमण, 7 अन्नप्राशन, 8 चूडाकर्मन्, 9 उपनयन, 10 केशान्त, 11 समावर्तन, and 12 विवाह; see <ls>Ms. 2. 26</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>; some writers increase the number to sixteen). .²15 Purification, purity. .²16 A rite or ceremony in general. .²17 Investiture with the sacred thread; मांसं मूत्रं पुरीषं च प्राश्य संस्कारमर्हति <ls>Mb. 12. 165. 76</ls>. .²18 Obsequial ceremonies. .²19 A polishing stone; संस्कारोल्लिखितो महामणिरिव क्षीणोऽपि नालक्ष्यते <ls>Ś. 6. 5</ls> (where संस्कार may mean ‘polishing’ also).
